title: WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One Agent From Narration to Long-Form Video
abstract: arXiv:2610.38352v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Producing long-form videos from narration requires interdependent decisions that remain coherent across shots. Existing agentic editors often use multi-stage workflows driven by general models, leaving the quality-cost trade-off of compact, task-adapted policies unclear. We address this gap with WeVisCut, a long-form script-to-video system that connects tool execution with policy learning. Its agent harness maintains shared production state so that tool feedback informs subsequent decisions and repairs. Because finished videos do not expose these decisions, our four-stage data pipeline combines editing inversion with verified replay to turn recovered editing intent into executable supervision. Applied to 3,750 finished videos, this pipeline yields over 130K training examples. translated_title: WeVisCut：一个智能体包揽整个剪辑室——从旁白到长视频
translated_abstract: 从旁白生成长视频需要在镜头之间保持连贯且相互依赖的决策。现有的智能体剪辑工具通常采用由通用模型驱动的多阶段工作流，使得紧凑的、面向任务的策略在质量与成本之间的权衡尚不明确。我们通过 WeVisCut 来填补这一空白，这是一个将工具执行与策略学习相连接的长视频脚本到视频系统。其智能体框架维护共享的制作状态，使工具反馈能够为后续决策和修复提供依据。由于成片视频并不暴露这些决策过程，我们的四阶段数据管线将剪辑逆向与经过验证的重放相结合，把恢复出的剪辑意图转化为可执行的监督信号。将该管线应用于 3,750 个成片视频，生成了超过 13 万条训练样本。我们利用这些监督数据训练了一个单一的 9B 策略模型，能够在同一框架内协调制作并从失败中恢复。此外，我们还引入了一个 100……
tldr: 论文提出 WeVisCut，一个连接工具执行与策略学习的长视频脚本到视频系统，通过四阶段数据管线从成片视频中恢复剪辑意图并生成超过 13 万条训练样本，进而训练出一个 9B 策略模型，在同一智能体框架内完成制作协调与故障恢复。
en_tdlr: WeVisCut is a long-form script-to-video system that connects tool execution with policy learning, using a four-stage data pipeline combining editing inversion and verified replay to recover editing intent into over 130K training examples, enabling a single 9B policy to coordinate production and recover from failures within one agent harness.
